name: The Reckoning of the Sixth Toll
hook: Veyl is dying with the tide. For six hundred years the Litany Sea has covered the Choir-Floor of Saint Marrow's Reach, and for six hundred years the crystals set into that floor have stayed solid, wet, and unreadable — a library nobody could open because…
setup: Play on a board divided into SIX numbered tidal bands running parallel to the shore edge, Band 1 (nearest shore) to Band 6 (deepest sea). Each band is covered by a double-sided terrain overlay: WET side up = Brine-deep, DRY side up = exposed Choir-Floor. At game start, ALL six bands are WET (Brine-deep). Place the Tide Track beside the board, a fixed strip of six notches labelled Toll I through Toll VI, with the Tide marker resting before Toll I. Place ONE Litany crystal model in the centre of each band — six crystals total, all starting Loose and all starting in Brine-deep zones (so all six begin shatter-immune). Crystals 1-2 are minor (1 Shatter destroys), crystals 3-4 are major (2…
deployment: Four-player free-for-all. The three living factions (Mnemarchs, Ash Iconoclasts, Brine-Factors) deploy along the SHORE edge only, within 6" of the board edge behind Band 1 — i.e. on dry land, with the entire wet sea between them and the deepest crystals. Roll off for deployment order; place alternately. No living model may begin in a Brine-deep band (you start on the shore and must advance into the receding tide as it opens). The Sediment (Veyl's swarm) does not deploy a starting force; the Sediment player instead takes the Grief pool and the Salt-dead reserve, and re-dreams Reliquiae onto the board as the Long Toll opens Dry ground for them (see Special Rules). The shore edge belongs to no…
objectives: Primary: control the most VALUE in INTACT crystals when the Sixth Toll strikes Dry and the game ends. A crystal scores for the player whose model is in base contact (Held), who has Set it (Mnemarch), or who has Liquidated it to the Hold (Brine-Factor) — a Loose crystal nobody controls scores for nobody, and a Shattered crystal scores for nobody and never did. Each living faction races the silent Toll Deck to LOCK value in before a rival contests it: Mnemarchs Set crystals in WET bands (sealed forever); Brine-Factors carry Loose crystals to the shore and Liquidate them into Coin (off-board, unsealable, un-re-dreamable); Iconoclasts deny all value by Shattering Exposed crystals in DRY bands…
twist: The tide does not drain in band order — it drains in a SECRET PROGRAMMED SEQUENCE revealed one notch at a time. Before the game, shuffle six band-tiles (numbered 1-6) face down into a Toll Deck. At the START of each round, before any activation, flip the top Toll Deck tile: THAT band flips from Wet…
